selectedTitle: Stolen AI Credits Are Funding a Black Market — Here's the Proof
description:
There's a shadow economy growing underneath the AI boom — and most people have no idea it exists. Token brokers are buying AI credits in bulk and reselling them for profit, reshaping how businesses access artificial intelligence. But who are these middlemen, who's buying from them, and what happens when the whole system collapses overnight?

In this video, we break down the AI credit resale economy: how the margin structure actually works, who the real customers are (hint: it's not just scrappy startups), and the compliance risks that nobody in this space wants to talk about. We also look at how major AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic are responding — and why formalizing this market may be smarter than trying to kill it.

Whether you're a developer, a business decision-maker, or just someone trying to understand how AI infrastructure actually works in the real world, this is a story that deserves your attention. The token broker market is consolidating fast, and the players who control AI credit distribution may end up controlling something far more significant.

Source & further reading: https://vectoral.com/blog/who-are-the-token-brokers
